summary: The most complete WI: header, part list, all four press operations and their settings and dimensions match the golden, including both 26 mm features. It fails on 20 critical additions, all but one PPAP data the golden leaves out (min/max shut heights, threads, tool and liner sizes, hourly and first/last-piece checks, 28 mm, R3 on Forming I, LH/RH bins, RPO, UNIT-III transfer and re-inspection, four new rework rows), plus an invented radius R5 on Forming II. The blanking chamfer 5x45° and blanking R3 are missing, and rusty raw material is sent back to the supplier.
